rules.title: List comprehension desugars to Vec build loop
rules.statement: A list comprehension `[value for x in iter (if guard)?]` desugars to a block that binds `let mut v: Vec<T> = vec_new::<T>()`, iterates `x` over `iter`, (optionally gated by `guard`) calls `Vec::push(&mut v, value)`, and evaluates to `v`. T is the iterator element type; the block's type is `Vec<T>`.
rules.divergence: Logos-specific surface syntax (Python-style comprehension); not present in Rust.

rules.title: Comprehension iterables restricted to array/slice
rules.statement: The iterable of any comprehension form must have type `[T; N]` (array) or `[T]` (slice); any other iterator type is rejected. Element type defaults to i32 when the array/slice element type is absent.
rules.divergence: Narrower than Rust: only concrete array/slice, no IntoIterator/Iterator protocol.
rules.uncertainty: i32 default for missing elem type is a fallback; normally elem type is always present.

rules.title: List comprehension requires Vec in scope
rules.statement: A list comprehension is ill-formed unless the `Vec` struct and the generic `vec_new` function are visible (via `use logos.mem.collections.vec;`).
rules.divergence: Logos-specific: surface sugar depends on a stdlib import being present.

rules.title: Comprehension binds the loop variable in value/guard scope
rules.statement: The loop variable `x` is bound (immutable, element type) in a new scope covering the value/key expressions and the guard; it is not visible outside the comprehension.

rules.title: Map comprehension desugars to HashMap build loop
rules.statement: A map comprehension `{key: value for x in iter (if guard)?}` desugars to a block that binds `let mut m: HashMap<K,V> = hashmap_new::<K,V>()`, iterates `x` over `iter`, (optionally gated by `guard`) calls `HashMap::insert(&mut m, key, value)`, and evaluates to `m`. K = type of `key`, V = type of `value`; block type is `HashMap<K,V>`.
rules.divergence: Logos-specific surface syntax; not present in Rust.

rules.title: Map comprehension requires HashMap in scope
rules.statement: A map comprehension is ill-formed unless the `HashMap` struct and the generic `hashmap_new` function are visible (via `use logos.mem.collections.hashmap;`).

rules.title: Writ list comprehension desugars to a Writ array builder loop
rules.statement: A writ list comprehension `@[value for x in iter (if guard)?]` desugars to a block that binds `let mut c = writ_list_comp_new(cap_hint)` (yielding the builder's return type, e.g. Rc<Writ>), iterates `x` over `iter`, coerces `value` to AnyVal, (optionally gated by `guard`) calls `writ_list_comp_push(&c, value)`, and evaluates to `c`. cap_hint = arr_size*8+128 for arrays of known size, else 128.
rules.divergence: Logos-specific Writ data-substrate sugar; no Rust equivalent.

rules.title: Writ list comprehension requires comp_builder import
rules.statement: A writ list comprehension is ill-formed unless arity-1 `writ_list_comp_new` and arity-2 `writ_list_comp_push` are visible (via `use logos.lang.writ.comp_builder;`).

rules.title: Writ comprehension guard must be bool
rules.statement: In a writ list/map comprehension the `guard` expression must have type `bool`; any other type is rejected (errors on Error type are swallowed to avoid cascades).

rules.title: Writ map comprehension desugars to a Writ object-map builder loop
rules.statement: A writ map comprehension `@{key: value for x in iter (if guard)?}` desugars to a block that binds `let mut c = writ_map_comp_new(cap_hint, slot_hint)`, iterates `x` over `iter`, coerces `value` to AnyVal, (optionally gated by `guard`) calls `writ_map_comp_put(&c, key, value)`, and evaluates to `c`. slot_hint = arr_size (else 64); cap_hint = arr_size*48+256 (else 4096).
rules.divergence: Logos-specific Writ sugar; no Rust equivalent.

rules.title: Writ map comprehension key must be str
rules.statement: In a writ map comprehension v1 the `key` expression must have type `str` (a `&[u8]` slice with u8 element); any other key type is rejected.

rules.title: Writ map comprehension requires comp_builder import
rules.statement: A writ map comprehension is ill-formed unless arity-2 `writ_map_comp_new` and arity-3 `writ_map_comp_put` are visible (via `use logos.lang.writ.comp_builder;`).

rules.title: Implicit coercion of comprehension element to AnyVal
rules.statement: Inside a Writ comprehension element/value, the value is coerced to AnyVal: WAny and legacy AnyVal struct values pass through unchanged; bool/i8/i16/i32/IntLit/u8/u16/u32 are wrapped via the matching `writ_coerce_<ty>` helper; `str` (`&[u8]`) is wrapped via `writ_coerce_str` (taking `&ctr` first). Any other type is rejected with a message to cast explicitly or wrap with AnyVal::embed_*.

rules.title: Wide integers not implicitly coerced to AnyVal
rules.statement: i64/u64/i24/u24/i56/u56/i128/u128 are intentionally NOT auto-coerced to AnyVal (implicit i32 embedding would silently truncate); the user must cast explicitly (`x as i32`) or wrap with WAny::from.

rules.title: Array fill literal repeats the element to length N
rules.statement: `[v; N]` produces an array literal of element type T (= type of v) with N copies; the element is re-lowered for each slot. N must be a positive integer; the element IntLit is left unresolved so struct-literal type inference can widen it.

rules.title: Array fill length via sizeof...(P)
rules.statement: `[v; sizeof...(P)]` where P is an in-scope type parameter yields a single-element array literal whose length is symbolic (`__sizeof_pack:P`); monomorphization repeats the element to the variadic pack's expanded length. Any spread operator other than `sizeof` is rejected; an undefined P is an error.

rules.title: Array fill length via metacall splice
rules.statement: `[v; metacall { <expr> }]` evaluates the block's tail expression by compile-time evaluation (CTFE), and the integer result becomes the array length. The metacall block must contain an integer tail expression. This is Logos's replacement for Rust const-eval at the array-length position.
rules.divergence: Logos explicit-metacall model replaces Rust const-expression array lengths.
